newsitem.title: USA: New England Electric, Eastern join marketing.
newsitem.headline: New England Electric, Eastern join marketing.

text.p: New England Electric System and Eastern Enterprises said on Wednesday they formed a venture to jointly market unregulated retail energy in the northeastern United States.
The new company would be called AllEnergy Marketing Company LLC, they said in a statement.
It would combine both companies' existing unregulated retail energy marketing subsidiaries and would be equally owned by both companies, they said.

These marketing subsidiaries -- NEES Energy Inc and Eastern's AllEnergy Marketing Company -- would be distinct from the companies' utility subsidiaries, they said. AllEnergy would be headquartered in Waltham, Mass.

"AllEnergy's goal is to become the leading energy marketer to businesses and households, initially in New England and New York," New England Electric System President and Chief Executive Officer John Rowe said in a statement.
Rowe said the move was taken in light of ongoing restructuring in the utility industry.

"This is the first instance in this market where two independent companies, one focused primarily on electricity and the other on natural gas, have come together to form a full-integrated unregulated energy marketing company," Eastern Chairman and CEO J. Atwood Ives said.

William Heil, president of Eastern's retail energy marketing company, would be chairman and chief executive officer, the companies said. John Dickson, president of NEES Energy Inc, would be president and chief operating officer.
